title: Cebu LGUs urged to brace for worst El Niño, drought

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — With drought conditions projected to hit Cebu by March 2027, the Cebu Provincial Board has urged local governments to secure water supplies and protect vulnerable communities before the effects of El Niño intensify.
